title: scn-nanoribbon-fet: code and data for "Edge orientation and termination in scandium nitride nanoribbon transistors: ballistic limits from Wannier building blocks"
description: Code (the scnfet Python package and analysis scripts) and data (DFT and Wannier90 inputs, Wannier Hamiltonians, Slater-Koster parameters and device results) for the paper "Edge orientation and termination in scandium nitride nanoribbon transistors: ballistic limits from Wannier building blocks". Code under the MIT licence; data under CC BY 4.0.
